selection_rule.basis: Selection is frozen from the preregistered structural threshold sweep before any downstream behavioral optimization. hDeltaG is the only tested 2022 local relay with nonzero hDeltaC->relay->PFL3 support at every fixed threshold through 10; hDeltaM is the strongest comparator at threshold 5 but has zero two-hop paths at threshold 10.
selection_rule.forbidden_use: Do not change relay membership because a navigation benchmark, lesion, rewire, or training run performs poorly.

secondary_hDeltaM_support.interpretation: Strong PFL-facing output but weaker hDeltaC-facing input than hDeltaG. Retained as a frozen comparator, not merged into the primary route.

other_preregistered_relays.hDeltaA: Very strong PFL3/PFL2-facing connectivity but hDeltaC input is only two weight-1 pairs; no two-hop path survives threshold 3.
other_preregistered_relays.hDeltaH: Moderate two-hop support at thresholds 1 and 3, but zero hDeltaC->hDeltaH->PFL3 paths survive threshold 5.

positive_control.interpretation: Independent goal-interface positive control only. It is not evidence for the hDeltaC relay hypothesis.

persistent_goal_lane.interpretation: The exact PFG type-name selector returned no MaleCNS annotation rows. The hDeltaK<->PFG hypothesis is unresolved by nomenclature in this audit and must not be called structurally absent. Alias/morphology mapping is required before testing it.

claim_boundary: This authority freezes a discovery-stage relay selection from structural MaleCNS evidence. It does not establish physiological transmission, synaptic sign, goal coding, necessity, sufficiency, or odor-navigation performance. The primary hDeltaG relay may advance to an independently frozen sign/topography/perturbation assay; relay identity must not be re-selected using behavioral performance.
